Class TelemetryEventFactory

java.lang.Object
com.example.TelemetryEventFactory
public class TelemetryEventFactory extends Object
Creates TelemetryEvents with the correct type, data keys and current time, so the rest of the plugin never builds events by hand. Takes a clock so tests can fix the time.

    • idleStartedAt

      public TelemetryEvent idleStartedAt(long timestampMillis)
      Creates a EventType.IDLE_START event with an earlier timestamp. Idle time is only noticed after the idle threshold has passed, so the event is backdated to when activity stopped.
      Parameters:
      timestampMillis - when the idle period actually began
      Returns:
      the new event
